mattpocock/skills._readme: Maps local skills to the upstream mattpocock skill they were adapted from, so sync-skills doesn't have to re-derive this every run. Update this file whenever a skill is renamed, split, merged, or newly absorbed/ported. 'noEquivalent' = verified original, nothing upstream to compare against. 'unrelatedPlugins' = whole plugin dirs confirmed to have no relationship to this source, skip entirely.

pendingDecisions.decision: Choose whether logic prototypes should remain host-language terminal apps or become single-file HTML demos with free-play controls and guided scenarios. HTML is easier to share with non-developers; the terminal version matches the host runtime and makes the portable logic easier to lift directly.

Choose whether to replace the explicit one-question-at-a-time contract with dependency-aware frontier rounds. Rounds are faster and permit parallel fact-finding; one-at-a-time reduces cognitive load and preserves focused decisions.

Choose whether to broaden and rename the user-invoked skill-focused reference into a model-invoked reference for every agent-facing document. Cache was ported independently; the broader change would also require updating write-a-skill and invocation metadata.
Choose whether to adopt the promoted wizard skill, which generates verified interactive bash scripts for human-only setup, credential, dashboard, migration, and cutover steps.

Choose whether to adopt the promoted to-questionnaire skill, which interviews about the recipient and needed outcome, then writes a Markdown discovery questionnaire for someone who holds missing knowledge.
Choose whether to adopt the new three-line wait-what corrective, which re-pitches the last message with more context, simplified English, and project vocabulary.
